50281003.DESCRIPTION: Inhibition of human recombinant carboxy-terminal His-tagged LDHA by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. Human recombinant carboxy-terminal His-tagged LDHA (100 μg/mL) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20. Compounds were dissolved in DMSO and diluted in running buffer to the desired concentrations. The flow rate was 30 μL/min. Association and dissociation times were 120 s and 180 s, respectively. Regeneration was performed with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The KD values were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. SPR data depicting the binding of compound 7 to LDHA in the presence (A) and absence (B) of NADH. The KD determined from fitting the kinetics is reported in panel A. In panel B, the KD was estimated relative to a control using methods described in Supplementary data. In both panels, the top concentration is 25 μM with injections related by a twofold dilution series. See Supplementary data for additional experimental details.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20

50281192.DESCRIPTION: Inhibition of human recombinant carboxy-terminal His-tagged LDHA by SPR assay in presence of +NADH

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. Human recombinant carboxy-terminal His-tagged LDHA (100 μg/mL) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% P20, 1 mM DTT. Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The association phase was 120 s, and the dissociation phase was 120 s. Regeneration was performed with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0. The SPR data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The KD values were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The experiments were performed in the presence and absence of 1 mM NADH.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. SPR data depicting the binding of compound 7 to LDHA in the presence (A) and absence (B) of NADH. The KD determined from fitting the kinetics is reported in panel A. In panel B, the KD was estimated relative to a control using methods described in Supplementary data. In both panels, the top concentration is 25 μM with injections related by a twofold dilution series. See Supplementary data for additional experimental details.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% P20, 1 mM DTT
